bio_en: Ms. Cecily is the founder and principal of Liberal Music & Arts School. With over 15 years of teaching experience, she specialises in traditional Chinese instruments and classical piano, nurturing hundreds of young musicians across Singapore.
bio_zh: Cecily老师是博雅音乐艺术学校的创办人及校长。她拥有超过15年的教学经验，专注于中国传统乐器及古典钢琴教育，培育了数百名新加坡青少年音乐家。

bio_en: Mr. Calvin is Vice Principal and our resident rhythm specialist. He brings infectious energy to every lesson, helping kids aged 4–16 discover the joy of percussion and string instruments in a fun, structured environment.
bio_zh: Calvin老师是副校长及节奏专家。他充满活力，帮助4至16岁的孩子在轻松愉快的环境中发现打击乐器和弦乐器的乐趣。

bio_en: Ms. Kate is a patient and nurturing piano teacher who specialises in early childhood music education. She has helped over 50 students achieve ABRSM distinctions and is beloved by students and parents alike.
bio_zh: Kate老师是一位耐心细心的钢琴老师，专注于儿童音乐启蒙教育。她帮助超过50名学生在ABRSM考试中取得优异成绩，深受学生及家长喜爱。

bio_en: Ms. Jiang is our specialist in both Western strings and traditional Chinese instruments. Her unique dual expertise allows her to guide students through the rich world of Chinese classical music alongside modern violin technique.
bio_zh: 姜老师精通西方弦乐及中国传统乐器，能够引导学生探索中国古典音乐的丰富世界，同时掌握现代小提琴演奏技巧。

bio_en: Mr. Leonard is our most versatile instructor, equally comfortable teaching drums, guitar, ukulele, or piano. His relaxed teaching style and genuine passion for music make him a favourite among older students and beginners alike.
bio_zh: Leonard老师是我们最全能的讲师，擅长教授爵士鼓、吉他、尤克里里及钢琴。他轻松的教学风格和对音乐的热忱，使他成为大龄学生及初学者的最爱。
